mentions.name: Jazz Tune Practice Tracker
mentions.description: An app that helps jazz musicians manage their tune list and serves as a practice and review tool. It highlights tunes that haven't been played in a while and might be forgotten, supports trying different keys or exercises on a tune, and tracks what the musician found difficult.
mentions.problem: Tunes on a musician's list can go unplayed for a while and risk being forgotten, with no easy way to track practice and note what was difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: Now I'm working on a smaller app for jazz musicians to manage their tune list and act as a tool to help practice and review tunes. I wanted this app to tell me what tunes on my list I haven't played in a while (and might forget), or try different keys or exercises on the tune and track what I found difficult.
